mapper.select: SELECT coordi_id AS coordiId, user_id AS userId, coordi_name AS coordiName, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM coordis WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = 'Y')
SELECT coordi_id AS coordiId, user_id AS userId, coordi_name AS coordiName, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM coordis WHERE coordi_id = #{coordiId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO COORDI_ITEMS T USING (SELECT #{coordiId} AS coordi_id, #{clothesId} AS clothes_id FROM DUAL) S ON (T.COORDI_ID = S.COORDI_ID AND T.CLOTHES_ID = S.CLOTHES_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y', T.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COORDI_ID, CLOTHES_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, IS_ACTIVE) VALUES (#{coordiId}, #{clothesId}, #{userId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(coordi_id, 8))), 0) + 1 FROM coordis WHERE SUBSTR(coordi_id, 2, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD')
mapper.update: UPDATE coordis SET coordi_name = #{coordiName}, description = #{description}, file_id = #{fileId}, canvas_json = #{canvasJson}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE coordi_id = #{coordiId}
UPDATE coordis SET ai_file_id = #{aiFileId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE coordi_id = #{coordiId}
